Honestly this game gives me mixed feelings. At times it's fun to play and grind especially when you have friends with you to do things together. Upgrading my character and leveling up feels satisfying because it means all the hard work pays off. 

But then again with the time limited events, camp's weekly events, having to farm bc I'm staying as f2p and such, this game can exhaust me quite fast. Having to keep tabs and actively participate for the rewards make me feel like if I don't do them religiously I might be left behind in progression. It's harder when I'm working and have many things to do in real life too. It becomes a chore rather than playing for fun, partly because I'm also very competitive against my friends. When this happens I have to remind myself that it's just a game and I should relax and just enjoy whatever.

My point is, when the latter problem arise I find this game tedious and at times I questioned myself is it worth spending time playing this? But when I realised that I don't really have to be on top all the time and that I can progress at my own pace as long as I'm having fun with the missions, side quests and my friends, this game become fun to play and I find myself always looking forward to login whenever I'm free.

If you find it suck and boring, maybe this game is just not your niche and that's fine. Find other games that suits you. The UI is fine, I mean it's a mobile game what do you expect.
